cases.name: Geralyn Barr DeSoto
cases.about: She was an LSU student who was planning to attend graduate school. Geralyn's father says she was a huge LSU fan and a really good basketball player. Described by her mother as a vibrant young woman, she said Geralyn was: "Athletic, easy-going -- she loved whatever it was she got herself into. If it was sports she gave it her 100%," said Melanie. "She was just an easy-going child, who never gave us any trouble. A child who a parent could be very proud of."
cases.narrative: He slit her throat ear to ear and stomped on her. Her husband found her body.
